page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external block storage for operating system and application data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute performance without resource contention from other tenants on the host.

With a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is classified as a general-purpose instance. It is suitable for workloads requiring high-frequency single-core performance alongside multi-core scaling, such as enterprise application hosting, web serving, and medium-sized database backends. The absence of bundled local storage and GPUs optimizes the resource profile for environments where external storage and CPU-bound processing are preferred.
